source_title: Bulletin, October 16, 2026, Revised Prima Facie Credit Life and Credit Accident and Sickness Insurance Rates
summary: Wisconsin's Commissioner of Insurance gave written notice on October 16, 2026 of a new basic loss ratio of 41% for credit life (45% in the September 28, 2023 bulletin) and new prima facie credit life rates for the three-year period beginning January 1, 2027. All six single and joint rates fall, by about 9% to 10%. Insurers using these rates must make a rate filing adopting them before January 1, 2027.
